release_notes: **Feedback and feature requests through the existing form**: the navbar item is now "Report Issue / Feedback". The form branches into Bug, Feedback (with a 1–5 rating) and Feature Request, and each submission is filed as a labeled issue. **Composer tooltips**: every block parameter and static input now has a tooltip. **Reconcile badge tooltip**: shows the last API contract-check time per broker. **Navbar**: two-row layout, the Recording tag shows only in market hours, and a token-expiry error during Option Scanner scans is reported correctly. Docs: design and product notes on the navbar indicator rule and deliberate non-goals (hotkeys, layout customization).
